title: Functorial invariants for chaos topology from data
summary: The templex is a topological object bridging homologies and templates for chaotic dynamics. This article places the templex within category theory, introducing a directed path algebra, an edge operator on directed paths, and an equivalence relation for directed cycles that is distinct from directed homologies. The resulting functorial invariants are of two kinds: abelian-group invariants, namely the homology groups, and semigroup invariants, namely the generatex semigroups.
